modules.name: Dual Timeline and Closed-loop Evidence Continuity

rules.description: A chapter gate card must include a concrete main event, worsening situation, reader-facing mainline, and next-chapter pursuit question.
Third-party review must surface abandonment risk before defending the project.
Every blind-read round must lock date, file order, word count, git ref or modified time, include/appendix state, ticket type, and questionnaire version before issuing tasks.
Human blind tickets, isolated agent tickets, and informed review must be counted separately; informed review cannot be counted as blind reading.

Blind readers may only receive locked manuscript text, neutral task text, and the questionnaire; prompts must not reveal author concerns, prior answers, outlines, settings, comments, or later chapters.
Substantive manuscript changes invalidate related old blind-read tickets; only mechanical typo, punctuation, and pure-format edits may preserve old tickets with an explicit record.
Formal blind-read decisions require at least two qualifying isolated agent or human tickets; one screening ticket cannot prove pass.
Single-chapter blind-read results and continuous blind-read results must not substitute for each other.
Formal quality scores and page-turner or commercial stickiness scores must be recorded separately and cannot be merged into one average.
Every formal single-chapter ticket must pass independently; averages cannot cover an incomplete read, wrong retell, key misread, low continuation score, or unwillingness to continue.
Single-chapter strong page-turner pass requires basic pass, strong continuation, character closeness, scene pressure, and a continuation reason rooted in a concrete character.

Continuous blind reading must read ordered chapters without substitution, record each chapter immediately, track first slow-down, first skim, stable fatigue, and block shared time misread, result pre-spoiling, hard chapter breaks, or stable skip zones.
Formal quality pass requires every qualifying ticket to meet the formal quality threshold and avoid logic, time, identity, professional-boundary, and causality hard injuries.

Continuous strong page-turner pass requires every qualifying ticket to meet the stickiness threshold, keep each chapter at least 4, immediately continue, avoid shared stable fatigue, and cite both a concrete character and unresolved event.

Blind-read work must use an internal temporary agent that does not create previewable tasks, does not inherit current conversation context, discards results after readback, and leaves no sidebar entry.
Release gate reports must flag TODO markers, placeholders, meta-writing residue, encoding markers, and forbidden expression classes.

Formal release review must include a dedicated human line-by-line pass for typos, incorrect characters, broken collocations, missing sentence components, unclear references, subject drift, quotation and punctuation errors, accidental repetition, and inconsistent names, ages, numbers, or object labels; mechanical scans alone do not satisfy this gate.
Release readiness and market-readability scores must be reported separately.
Cold-read review must flag drafts that lack a current-page human exchange or reader-facing handle.
Emotion must land on body, object, relationship, or changed behavior instead of staying concept-only.

Key evidence, injuries, marks, concealment, reveal order, and on-page actions must be physically operable through position, obstruction, angle, light, distance, posture, tools, timing, and procedure instead of appearing only when suspense requires them.
Physical operability explanations must contain a concrete evidence or action target and enough physical support anchors; generic statements such as 'physically reasonable' are not enough.
Small evidence objects such as wet paper, paper corners, medicine tags, broken needles, seal slips, or page fragments must specify a handling action that matches their size and state.

The same object must keep a continuous physical state across beats; it must not shift between palm-sized item and bundle-sized package, or between protected fragile support and direct edge pinching without explanation.
Dual-timeline or body-switch chapters must track both bodies, locations, elapsed one-to-one time, post-exit care or movement, and next wake position.

Already observed facts such as photographed, recorded, measured, numbered, or archived evidence cannot retroactively change; later action may reveal unobserved layers or change interpretation, not rewrite observed facts.

A cross-boundary artifact exception must have a complete lifecycle: old observed state, present/source state, active trigger or carry condition, one-way cost or modern loss, handoff/use, and final storage or evidence state.
Selected visual assets must have a visual card, prompt record, version state, selection basis, and usage purpose.
Novel mode must not emit shot lists, camera instructions, or production checklists unless screenplay or short_drama mode is explicit.
